source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
A **DRUKHARI** [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction) may add **HARLEQUINS** and **ANHRATHE** units without the **DRUKHARI** Faction keyword, up to a combined points limit set by [battle size](vsdata:core-rule/select-battle-size):

- **Incursion**: 250 pts.
- **Strike Force**: 500 pts.
- **Onslaught**: 750 pts.

These models can never be your **WARLORD** or receive Enhancements.
